title: Type specimen: a size ladder to the legibility floor
stressor: mixed font sizes from display heading to small text near the 10px legibility floor
notes: Self-contained single page, all CSS inline, no script, no network URLs. Designed for a 960x640 viewport (120x40 at 8x16). A type specimen that repeats one pangram down a descending size ladder: 60px display heading, 34px heading, 24px subhead, 18px body, 14px, 11px, and a 9px caption. Each row is labelled with its px size. The ladder walks through and below Nyala's bitmap legibility floor (about 10px capital height; 8px illegible) so the crisp text overlay can be measured against the block path. White background, dark text. Prose is the standard pangram; copy is original.
